Frequently Asked Questions

How does referral tracking work?

When a visitor clicks your unique referral link (`/go/YOUR_CODE`), a secure 60-day cookie (`iinsha_aff_ref`) is saved in their browser. If they purchase or request a quote on WhatsApp within 60 days, your code is automatically attached and credited to your ledger.

How and when do I get paid?

Payouts are processed within 24 hours of request. You can withdraw earnings once you reach $50 via bKash, Nagad, Wise Bank Wire, PayPal, Payoneer, or Crypto USDT (TRC20).

Can I promote via social media & email?

Yes! You can use our built-in AI Copywriter inside the partner dashboard to generate pre-formatted posts for LinkedIn, Twitter, Facebook, WhatsApp groups, and email newsletters.

Is self-referral allowed?

No. To maintain network integrity, self-referrals (buying through your own link) are automatically detected and flagged by our fraud shield engine.
